description: PPRi secteur Épernay – carte de l’aléa (crue centennale) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Area exposed to one or more hazards represented on the hazard map used for risk analysis of flood RPP. The hazard map is the result of hydraulic modelling, carried out in 2014 by the SAFEGE study office, whose objective was to assess the intensity of the hazard at any point in the study area. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Dataset Direct Download Service (WFS): PPRI sector Épernay — map of the hazard (crue centennial)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WFS 1.1.0. The listing shows 2023-12-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
